subject: Scheduling: Security evidence & architecture deep-dive (SOC 2 prep) - FinLytics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cara Morales <cara@finlytics.com>, FinLytics SecOps <secops@finlytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Security evidence & architecture deep-dive (SOC 2 prep) - FinLytics

Hi Cara / SecOps team —

Thanks again for taking the time to work through SOC 2 prep with us. To make the architecture review productive, we'd like to schedule a focused deep-dive that covers:

- SSO & IdP flow (SCIM, provisioning, SAML/OIDC details)
- Encryption (at-rest, in-transit, KMS key management)
- Audit logs & retention (access logs, token logs, access reviews)
- Evidence handoff process & timeline (how we deliver artifacts, formats)

Proposed meeting length: 60 minutes (45 min presentation / 15 min Q&A).

Calendar options (PDT):
- Tue May 18 — 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed May 19 — 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, send us two slots that do.

Prep items we will bring: our SOC 2 evidence checklist (attached), network diagram, encryption overview, and a short list of required temporary permissions for logs access. Could you share any evidence templates or your preferred deliverable formats ahead of time?

Attachments: redwood_soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)

Action items:
- Please confirm preferred slot and attendee list from your side
- If you have a technical pre-read or doc, share it so we can tailor the walkthrough

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform.
From: Cara Morales <cara@finlytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinLytics SecOps <secops@finlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Security evidence & architecture deep-dive (SOC 2 prep) - FinLytics

Rachel — thanks for the clear agenda. We should be able to cover everything you listed. A couple of notes from our side before we lock the time:

- Our security team prefers not to meet before 11:00 EDT on weekdays. Eastern time zone: please keep that in mind when proposing PDT slots.
- We will include two platform engineers (Jamal and Priya) from SecOps; they will want to dive into how you handle KV cache, log export, and key lifecycle.
- Please send a short list of the exact artifacts you expect (logs, config exports, encryption keys metadata) so our compliance lead can pre-stage files.

Availability (EDT):
- Tue May 18 — 17:00–18:00 EDT (that maps to your 10:00–11:00 PDT) — good for us
- Wed May 19 — 12:00–13:00 EDT (maps to your 09:00–10:00 PDT) — also possible

I'll attach our internal evidence template; we use that to map requested items to owners. Also, we'll need a signed NDA (we have a standard DocuSign link) before sharing some log extracts.

Attachment: finlytics-evidence-template.xlsx (stub)

Regards,
Cara Morales
Director, Information Security | FinLytics
cara@finlytics.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cara Morales <cara@finlytics.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Security evidence & architecture deep-dive (SOC 2 prep) - FinLytics

Thanks, Cara — appreciate the template. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Attendees from Redwood: Rachel (SE lead), myself (Solutions), Marcus (Infra lead). Marcus will cover log export formats and retention policies.
- We'll prepare an artifact list that maps to your template so it's easy for your team to hand over items.
- For the NDA: Rachel, can you send the DocuSign link to Cara? We can get that routed quickly.

Proposal: Let's take Tue May 18 10:00–11:00 PDT (17:00–18:00 EDT). I'll send a calendar invite with an internal 30-minute sync for Redwood-only 30 minutes before the joint call so we're aligned on demos and handoffs.

Suggested agenda (60m):
1) 5m — Introductions & scope
2) 20m — Architecture: how we collect and retain logs, encryption at rest/in-transit, KMS integration
3) 15m — Evidence handoff & formats (how we package CSV/JSON/console exports)
4) 15m — Q&A / next steps

Logistics: if FinLytics wants AWS CloudTrail extracts, toggle for limited-time access for a service account works best. We'll document the temporary IAM policy required.

Thanks — I will await Rachel's invite and the signed NDA link.

- Logan
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
From: Cara Morales <cara@finlytics.com>

On Sun, May 16, 2027 at 8:45 AM PDT Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Proposal: Let's take Tue May 18 10:00–11:00 PDT (17:00–18:00 EDT). I'll send a calendar invite with an internal 30-minute sync for Redwood-only 30 minutes before the joint call so we're aligned on demos and handoffs.

That time works — confirming Jamal and Priya will attend. A couple of prep asks: 

- Please include a short (one-page) summary of your retention policy for audit logs and any configurable retention knobs. We need that to map to our evidence matrix.
- If you will show examples of exported logs, can you limit sensitive PII fields or indicate redaction approach?
- Our infra team is in us-east-1; if you need to reference region-specific details please call that out in the agenda.

We signed and returned the NDA via DocuSign earlier today (link: https://www.docusign.com/FinLytics/NDA-12345).

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Cara
